semantic_review.rope_backward_transform: The selected original Python JIT/wrapper and public Correct/FPEquiv/IO/Contract files are unchanged. Original and existing index-shared candidate are complete 23-statement raw bodies, with four pointer floating families, seven runtime mathematical integer bindings and nine constexpr roles outside. Unlike the forward task, cosine and sine have independent column strides; both remain at the exact coefficient loads, including zero strides.
